stored.label: Choice recorded in the administration
stored.on: On: maintenance mode will stay on once TT_MAINTENANCE is removed
stored.off: Off: maintenance mode will end once TT_MAINTENANCE is removed

forced.title: Forced by the environment
forced.text: The instance was started with TT_MAINTENANCE=true: maintenance mode stays on whatever is chosen here, until the variable is removed and the instance restarted.
forced.save: You can still edit the messages. Saving them also records maintenance mode as on in the administration: after removing TT_MAINTENANCE, turn it off here.

enabled.label: Maintenance mode on
enabled.hint: Refuses new deposits on every entity and shows the maintenance page.
enabled.forcedHint: Cannot be turned off here while TT_MAINTENANCE=true forces the mode.

message.hint: Optional, plain text, {max} characters at most. Line breaks are kept; formatting and links are not. It is shown under the standard maintenance text; when empty, visitors using this language see the message of the other language, if any.
message.warning: These messages are shown on the public page of every entity, to anyone: write nothing confidential (no internal names, addresses or details of your infrastructure).

preview.title: Preview
preview.intro: The messages are shown as plain text under the standard maintenance text, exactly as below.
preview.empty: No message in this language: the message of the other language is shown, if any.

enable.title: Turn maintenance mode on?
enable.text: New deposits will be refused on every entity until maintenance mode is turned off. Uploads in progress are suspended and resume once it is turned off.

disable.title: Turn maintenance mode off?
disable.text: New deposits will be accepted again on every entity.

keepAfterEnvironment.title: Record maintenance mode as on?
keepAfterEnvironment.text: While TT_MAINTENANCE=true forces the mode, saving also records it as on in the administration: maintenance mode will stay on once the variable is removed, until you turn it off here.

saved.enabled: Maintenance mode is on: new deposits are refused on every entity.
saved.disabled: Maintenance mode is off: new deposits are accepted again.

errors.tooLong: The message is longer than {max} characters.
errors.forbiddenCharacter: The message contains an invisible or control character (other than a line break). Remove it, for example by typing the text again instead of pasting it.
errors.invalidMessage: The message must be plain text of 1 to {max} characters, without control or invisible direction characters other than line breaks.
errors.forced: Maintenance mode cannot be turned off: TT_MAINTENANCE=true forces it. The state has been reloaded.
